description: Source file implementing bounds inference and overlap analysis for tensor operations in PyTorch JIT, including functions for merging tensor accesses, inferring bounds, and detecting memory hazards.

methods.name: mergeTensorAccesses
methods.description: Merges tensor access information, updating bounds and access kinds for tensor buffers.

methods.name: getAllBufs
methods.description: Retrieves a map of variables to buffers from statements or expressions.

methods.name: inferBounds
methods.description: Infers tensor bounds within a statement, considering access kinds.

methods.name: getInferredBounds
methods.description: Retrieves bounds within an analysis context for statements or expressions.

methods.name: printBoundsInfo
methods.description: Prints bounds information to standard error.

methods.name: getBoundExtents
methods.description: Calculates extents of tensor bounds for buffer size estimation.

methods.name: getPotentialHazards
methods.description: Detects potential memory hazards (RAW, WAR, WAW) between two statements.

methods.name: hasConflictingOverlap
methods.description: Checks if two bounds have overlapping regions that could cause conflicts.

methods.name: isOverlapping
methods.description: Checks if two memory regions (stores or load/store pairs) overlap.
